payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterative 1D DP over compressed frequency array where state dp[i] is maximum points using first i distinct values, with adjacent conflict resolved via max(skip, take).
payload.rationale: The solution compresses sorted input into (value, count) pairs and uses a flat DP array. Transition depends only on previous state(s) (dp[i-1] and possibly dp[i-2]), which is textbook dp_1d_state.
